tagline.en: Tencent's Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA — an Apache-2.0 vision-language-action model for robot policy, including bimanual manipulation.
tagline.zh: 腾讯的 Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA——Apache-2.0 的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于机器人策略，含双臂操作。

en: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA is Tencent's vision-language-action (VLA) model for embodied robotics. It maps camera observations and instructions to robot actions, driving policy rollouts for tasks including bimanual manipulation.

It ships in two checkpoints tuned for different setups: a UMI variant that outputs a chunk of 50 relative action steps, and a RoboTwin variant that returns 20 relative plus 20 absolute steps and can blend a supplied start pose. Both use a MoT (Mixture-of-Transformers) backbone and take multi-camera, multi-frame observations — RoboTwin, for example, uses six history frames from three cameras. Both checkpoints are Apache-2.0.

In WorldFoundry it runs as an inference-only path — architecture, backbone, preprocessing, and action decoding are kept in-tree — and defaults to strictly local checkpoints. Give it the observation frames and it decodes an action chunk for the robot.
zh: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA 是腾讯面向具身机器人的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。它把相机观测与指令映射为机器人动作，驱动包括双臂操作在内的策略 rollout。
它提供两个针对不同配置调优的 checkpoint：UMI 变体输出一段 50 步相对动作；RoboTwin 变体返回 20 步相对加 20 步绝对动作，并可对传入的起始位姿做融合。两者都采用 MoT（Mixture-of-Transformers）主干，接受多相机、多帧观测——例如 RoboTwin 使用来自三个相机的六帧历史。两个 checkpoint 均为 Apache-2.0。
在 WorldFoundry 中它以仅推理路径运行——架构、主干、预处理与动作解码都内置在仓库内——并默认严格使用本地 checkpoint。给它观测帧，它便为机器人解码出一段动作。

whenToUse.en: Use Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA for robot policy rollouts from multi-camera observations — pick the UMI or RoboTwin checkpoint to match your setup, including bimanual manipulation tasks.
whenToUse.zh: 适合从多相机观测做机器人策略 rollout——根据你的配置选择 UMI 或 RoboTwin checkpoint，涵盖双臂操作任务。

notFor.en: It expects proper multi-camera, multi-frame robot observations; a single replicated image works only for smoke tests, not for benchmark-quality rollouts. Checkpoints are kept strictly local.
notFor.zh: 它需要规范的多相机、多帧机器人观测；单张复制图像只适合冒烟测试，无法用于基准质量的 rollout。checkpoint 严格保存在本地。

en: Vision-language-action model for robot policy and bimanual manipulation
UMI and RoboTwin checkpoints, both Apache-2.0
Multi-camera, multi-frame observation inputs; inference-only, local checkpoints
